limits: Historical snapshots have been used in earlier research; this is not a fresh unseen final test.
Each invocation locks selection on development expanding-window log loss before holdout scoring.
Equal trial counts do not imply equal wall-clock cost, search priors or a definitive optimizer ranking.
One training seed and eight trials per optimizer/model; no cross-season deployment claim.
L1 means regularized multinomial logistic classification, not regression of numeric outcome codes.
No model bundles, live forecasts, source cache or warehouse records are replaced.
Some configurations do not converge within the fixed solver budget. Failed trials are retained and excluded, not treated as valid numerical scores.
XGBoost retains its existing training-prefix class weighting; logistic models use unweighted multinomial loss. This compares the stated configurations, not regularization in isolation.

numerical_development_probe.scope: Training-only PL451 and FL1397 prefixes; final holdout labels were not used.
numerical_development_probe.limit: This probes one problematic development prefix, not a global solver error bound.
